answer: A work-staked attestation grove resists Sybil attacks by making each identity earn trust through verifiable computation rather than free self-assertion. A new agent must complete useful verification tasks and stake a refundable deposit before its attestations count, like a lantern that only shines after fuel is spent. Creating thousands of fakes requires paying the same work and stake for each island of fake accounts, while honest peers prune identities whose work fails checks, so attacker cost scales linearly with every fake identity while defenders verify cheaply.
